sources.notes: Official BCAC page provides the Zhang et al. 2020 overall-breast-cancer results for women of European ancestry and links this public Drive file. The official data dictionary defines GRCh37 var_name and rsid:position:non-effect:effect tags; the source-specific materializer retains only autosomal tags explicitly carrying an rsID that agree with documented GRCh37 coordinates and meta-analysis alleles. Meta beta is log(OR), sdE.meta is its SE, and p.meta is used. The source audit records one repeated-header fragment, one incomplete record, and 235914 non-autosomal rows (including 4 chromosome-X allele conflicts); all are excluded while any autosomal conflict fails. No upstream checksum was supplied; the complete, range-validated 4,764,280,363-byte archive has local SHA-256 recorded here. The trait registry cites an explicit 13.0% US female lifetime-risk approximation for liability conversion.

GWAS Catalog GCST006085 reports 79,148 European-ancestry cases and 61,106 European-ancestry controls. Its supplied data dictionary documents B37 positions, rs_id, Allele1 effect allele, control Freq1, beta Effect (OR=exp(beta)), StdErr, Pvalue, and OncoArray imputation r2. The exact public archive was range-validated; no upstream checksum was supplied, so local SHA-256 is registered here. The checksum-pinned release has 20,065,528 data rows: exactly 367 unrecoverable non-16-field records, 5,887,673 non-rsID labels, 1,104,805 non-SNP alleles, and 391,229 non-autosomal records are excluded by a fail-closed source-specific materializer, leaving 12,681,454 harmonization-eligible rows and a provenance sidecar. The source asks users to cite Schumacher et al. 2018 and acknowledge PRACTICAL. The trait registry uses an explicit 13.2% US male lifetime-risk approximation for liability conversion.

The EBI archive contains 23 chromosome tables and its supplied SummaryOvarianResultsDescription.docx defines European analyses, with overall as all invasive. It defines Effect/Baseline, effect-allele EAF, R2_oncoarray, and a log-odds ratio (despite the overall_OR column name), SE and p-value. The source-specific materializer retains autosomal, source-explicit rsID A/C/G/T SNPs only. It materialized 14,936,299 of 19,911,988 source rows to ovarian_cancer.txt.gz (SHA-256 57a0b17ca9cbd513307d1bacceab279652ed824959fdff0dda83445fe4ee9e10); all excluded source-row categories are documented in docs/cancer_source_queue.md. The selected overall-invasive phenotype has 22,406 cases and 40,941 controls; the parent paper also reports 3,103 low-malignant-potential cases separately. No upstream checksum was supplied; this exact 3,774,309,689-byte public archive has the local SHA-256 registered here. The trait registry uses an explicit 1.1% US female lifetime-risk approximation for liability conversion.
